tools.name: wechat_send
tools.description: Reply to the bound WeChat user. Send the full reply in one call; text over 4000 characters is split automatically.

summary.en: Reply to the bound WeChat user.

path.description: Absolute image path in an allowed directory.

caption.description: Separate text sent before the image.

summary.zh: 把本地一张图片发到微信。
summary.en: Send a local picture to WeChat.

tools.name: wechat_send_file
tools.description: Reply with a local file. Videos and images use their native media types.

path.description: Absolute file path in an allowed directory.

caption.description: Separate text sent before the file.

summary.zh: 把本地一个文件发到微信。
summary.en: Send a local file to WeChat.

tools.name: wechat_send_voice
tools.description: Reply with audio from a local path or a host blob. Sends MP3 by default.

path.description: Absolute WAV, MP3 or SILK v3 path in the workspace or inbox.

blob.description: Audio log:/mem: handle or its [blob ...] receipt line.

fallback_text.description: Text to send on audio failure. Defaults to a failure notice.

summary.zh: 发送本地音频或宿主音频附件，默认发 MP3 文件卡片。
summary.en: Send local audio or a host audio blob, as an MP3 attachment by default.

tools.name: wechat_speak
tools.description: With TTS enabled, reply with synthesized speech. Falls back to the original text on audio failure.

summary.zh: 启用 TTS 时，将文字合成后发到微信，音频失败时补发原文。
summary.en: When TTS is enabled, synthesize and send audio to WeChat, with the original text as a fallback.

tools.name: wechat_status
tools.description: Check WeChat connection, allowed send paths, active Provider input support and recent attachment results.

mimes.description: Exact MIME types to check, e.g. audio/wav or application/pdf.

summary.zh: 查看连接、附件状态与模型输入能力。
summary.en: Check connection, attachments and model input support.

kind.description: Event kind or * glob, e.g. message/private.

summary.zh: 按类型和时间查已归档的微信事件。
summary.en: Read archived WeChat events by kind and time.

description.zh: 一条微信私聊消息。默认合并后投递，投递方式可在配置页修改。正文包含媒体路径，Provider 支持的文件随消息附上。不支持原生视频时尝试抽帧。
description.en: A WeChat 1:1 message. Incoming messages are batched by default, and delivery can be configured. The message includes local media paths and attaches files accepted by the Provider. Video falls back to frames.

description.zh: 绑定状态变化：绑定成功或会话过期。
description.en: The binding changed: bound, or the session expired.

prompts.title: 微信 ClawBot · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
微信私聊（{{wechat.state | 状态未知}}）。入站事件为 `wechat-claw.message`，正文以 `[微信 …]` 开头。
工作区：`{{wechat.workspace | 未知}}`。收件目录：`{{wechat.inbox | 未知}}`。

- 用微信发送工具回复绑定用户，需有效的入站回复凭据。文字、媒体和说明共用额度，凭据失效或额度用尽时等对方再发消息。只补发未发出的内容，回执确认已补发的文字勿重发。
- `wechat_send` 启用语义分段时，按换行、句号、语气标点的优先级择一切分，连续标点成组保留。
- 发送本地文件用允许目录内的绝对路径。图片和文件可用工作区、收件目录或配置放行的目录。外发意图不明确时先确认。
- 转发工具生成的音频时，将回执的句柄填入 `wechat_send_voice` 的 `blob`。
- 正文提供本地媒体路径。以实际收到的附件、可读文件或微信语音转写为依据，按标注顺序看视频帧。缺少内容时说明已知原因，勿猜测；用 `wechat_status` 查输入能力和附件状态。
